# True Love Creative

> Creative studio in Dubai, UAE, for brands, businesses and anyone with an idea. Web design, brand identity, graphic design and app development since 2015. Serving clients worldwide. A brand of BeatLabs FZE LLC.

True Love Creative designs and builds by hand: no templates, no page builders. The studio works with fewer clients to go deeper on each project, from the first idea to launch. Founded in 2015 by Javi Beat, designer and creative director based in Dubai. Languages: English, Spanish, Arabic. Reply within 24 hours.

## Services

- [Web Design](https://truelovecreative.es/services/web-design): Fast, precise websites built by hand. No templates, no page builders. Price: From AED 8,000.
- [Brand Identity](https://truelovecreative.es/services/branding): Logo, type, colour and voice: the kit a brand needs to be recognised at a glance. Price: After a short call.
- [Graphic Design](https://truelovecreative.es/services/graphic-design): Covers, posters, flyers and social systems with intention behind every pixel. Price: Per piece.
- [App Development](https://truelovecreative.es/services/app-development): iOS, Android and web apps, from the first sketch to the store. Price: Once scoped.

## Work

- [Jessica Morari](https://truelovecreative.es/work/jessica-morari): A cohesive brand and digital platform for a coaching professional redefining wellness in the UAE. (Branding & Web Design, 2023; live site jessicamorari.com)
- [Kiko Navarro](https://truelovecreative.es/work/kiko-navarro): A digital stage worthy of a legend. Web design for one of house music's most revered artists. (Web Design & Development, 2024; live site kikonavarro.es)
- [Javi Beat](https://truelovecreative.es/work/javi-beat): Forging a visual identity for a DJ who has called Dubai home for over a decade, and the world his dancefloor. (Identity & Web Design, 2024; live site javibeat.com)
- [Estrela Photo](https://truelovecreative.es/work/estrela-photo): A portfolio that lets the photographs speak. Clean, fast, and designed to convert browsers into clients. (Portfolio Web Design, 2023; live site estrela.photo)
- [Manuel KevSax](https://truelovecreative.es/work/manuel-kevsax): A luxury digital presence for a saxophonist who performs at the world's most exclusive stages. (Web Design & Development, 2024; live site manuelkevsax.com)
- [Julio Cuba](https://truelovecreative.es/work/julio-cuba): An artistic identity and digital portfolio for a violinist whose performances turn moments into memories. (Identity & Web Design, 2024; live site juliocuba.es)
- [Sergio Trumpet](https://truelovecreative.es/work/sergio-trumpet): A bold digital portfolio for a musician who brings the house down, trumpet in one hand, the crowd in the other. (Portfolio & Web Design, 2024; live site sergiotrumpetdj.com)

## Articles

- [Accessible Design Is Good Business](https://truelovecreative.es/blog/accessible-design-is-good-business): Contrast, readable text, keyboard use, captions, dark mode, calmer motion and clear forms. Why accessible design helps every customer, plus a plain-language checklist to bring to your designer.
- [How to Write a Website Brief That Gets You an Accurate Quote](https://truelovecreative.es/blog/how-to-write-a-website-brief): Most quotes go wrong before any design starts. Here is what to prepare before you brief a designer or studio, the mistakes I see most often, and how our brief form asks the right questions for you.
- [Will AI Replace Graphic Designers? An Honest Answer](https://truelovecreative.es/blog/will-ai-replace-graphic-designers): I use AI in my studio every day, so this isn’t a defensive rant but an honest look at what AI changed in graphic design, what it can’t do, and why a conversation before you spend is the cheapest insurance.
- [The Real Cost of an AI-Generated Logo](https://truelovecreative.es/blog/the-real-cost-of-an-ai-generated-logo): AI logo generators are everywhere and sometimes they’re fine, but there are costs the demo never shows: legal, practical and strategic. Read this before a generated logo goes on anything hard to change.
- [7 Signs Your Website Is Costing You Clients](https://truelovecreative.es/blog/signs-your-website-is-costing-you-clients): Most owners rarely look at their own website, yet every potential client checks it before they call. Seven honest checks to run on your site today, and what to do with the results.
- [Web Design in the Age of AI: Why Handmade Still Wins](https://truelovecreative.es/blog/web-design-in-the-age-of-ai): AI builders produce a website in minutes, and they all look alike. Here’s how that changed what businesses should pay for, and why a site made by hand is worth more now, not less.
- [How to Get Found When People Ask AI Instead of Google](https://truelovecreative.es/blog/how-to-get-found-in-ai-search): More people now ask ChatGPT, Perplexity or Google’s AI Overviews for recommendations. If AI can’t read your website, you don’t exist in that conversation. Here’s what any business can do about it.
- [What to Look for When Hiring a Web Designer in Dubai](https://truelovecreative.es/blog/what-to-look-for-when-hiring-a-web-designer-in-dubai): You searched “web designer Dubai” and now you’re drowning in options. Here’s how to tell who actually delivers, from someone who has been designing and building websites in Dubai since 2015.
- [How Much Does a Website Cost in Dubai?](https://truelovecreative.es/blog/how-much-does-a-website-cost-in-dubai): Everyone asks it, most agencies dodge it. Here’s what websites cost across the Dubai market, why the range is so wild, which hidden costs to ask about, and how to get a real number for your project.
- [Why Every DJ, Musician and Performer Needs a Professional Website](https://truelovecreative.es/blog/why-every-dj-needs-a-website): Thousands of followers and zero control over your brand. Why DJs, musicians and every kind of performer need a site of their own, what it should include, and why AI assistants now make it matter more.
